lines.text: *Wham!* *Crack!*

lines.speaker: tatoobodyguard
lines.text: Gyaaaaah!

lines.speaker: scarbodyguard
lines.text: Ja-Jaaaaames!!
Milk and Ade cover me,
taking down the incoming bodyguards one by one.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Next!

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Hah...!
Milk, behind you!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Got it!
*Wham!*

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Master, get down!
Right after I duck, Ade's leg cuts through the air with a sharp swoosh.
*Smack!*
The bodyguard trying to tackle me is sent flying.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: There, that one! Aim for him!

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Those two are trying to protect him!

lines.speaker: bodyguards
lines.text: Yes, Boss!

lines.speaker: scarbodyguard
lines.text: The one who took down Thomas and James...!
Before I know it, the bodyguards zero in on me and charge all at once.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Heh, check these fools out.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Master! The target!
Before I realize it, the target is already heading down the pathway on the opposite side of the VIP entrance, heading toward Coin Rush.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Bah!

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Boys, hold the girls back!

lines.speaker: bodyguards
lines.text: Yes, Boss!
*Thump thump thump*

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Look, he's making a run for the Main Hall!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: If he makes it there, he's gonna be a real pain to catch!

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Oh dear!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: What the heck is with these guys?!
The bodyguards abandon any thought of attacking
and instead throw their bodies at Milk and Ade, holding on tight.
*Thud!* *Wham!*

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Hey, let go! Get off me!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Ugh, gross!

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Master, go after him!
On it!
*Thump thump thump*
Just as I barrel down the inner corridor where the target disappeared, a transmission comes through.

lines.speaker: exia_b_op
lines.text: Nice work, Noob.
Exia! I need the target's location!

lines.speaker: exia_b_op
lines.text: He's about to enter Coin Rush's Main Hall.
Ugh...

lines.speaker: exia_b_op
lines.text: Hold on, I'll try to buy you some time.

lines.speaker: exia_b_op
lines.text: Locking down the main corridor.

lines.speaker: rouge_b_op_r
lines.text: ... As soon as the hallway was locked, a commotion broke out.

lines.speaker: rouge_b_op_r
lines.text: Highroller, please capture him as quickly as possible.
I'm sprinting as fast as I can...!
*Thump thump thump*

lines.speaker: rouge_b_op_r
lines.text: ... The guests have already started to complain.

lines.speaker: bay_b_op
lines.text: ... I-I'll try to draw their attention!
Bay?

lines.speaker: rouge_b_op_r
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: bay_b_op
lines.text: I'll do some cheerleading in the Main Hall if I have to...!

lines.speaker: bay_b_op
lines.text: Clay's probably nearby too!

lines.speaker: rouge_b_op_r
lines.text: ... I'll make an announcement about Rewind putting on a special performance before the event starts.

lines.speaker: exia_b_op
lines.text: Broadcast preparation complete.

lines.speaker: exia_b_op
lines.text: Go ahead.
I'm counting on you!
*Thump thump thump*
*Pant pant!*
*Ding dong ding dong*

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: Hello, everyone, and welcome to Coin Rush.

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: This is your Game Master, Rouge.

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: Before today's main event begins, a special performance from the renowned cheerleading team, Rewind,

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: will be held right here in the Main Hall. Bay—my apologies—both members of Rewind will be taking the stage.

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: Please take your seats and enjoy the show.

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: Once again,

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: before today's main event begins...

lines.speaker: exia_b_op
lines.text: The target failed to open the door to the Main Hall,

lines.speaker: exia_b_op
lines.text: then slipped into the waiting room right next to it.
The waiting room, right?

lines.speaker: exia_b_op
lines.text: There's no escape route, so it looks like he's given up.

lines.speaker: exia_b_op
lines.text: It's time to put an end to this.
*Step step*
*Click*
As I enter the waiting room, the sight before me is different from what I expected.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Hmm. You're late.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Did you come alone?
The man is lounging rather comfortably on a sofa.
What's your game?
Why are you so relaxed after running off like that?

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: I realized that there's no need for me to be in a hurry.
The target slowly gets up from the sofa.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: But you coming here alone to catch me

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: means one of two things:

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Either my men did their job too well, or you're just plain foolish.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Or maybe, it's both.
You sure have a way with words.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Haha. I'll take that as a compliment.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Originally, I thought I'd just get caught and then call in a favor to get released.
*Crack crack*
The man cracks his neck and stretches.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: But plans have changed.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: To you who ruined my work, I'll show you...

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: the strength...

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: of someone who clawed his way up from the bottom...!
You talk like some self-made businessman or something...
Come on, you're just a criminal...
The man puts both fists up and stares at me.
Pull out your gun and take aim.
Show off the hand-to-hand skills you practiced with Milk.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: What the...?!

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: How cowardly of you to pull a gun...!
Life isn't a game to me.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Pssh...

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: ... Putting on a bluff, I see.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: It's clear you don't have the guts to shoot me...!
*Click*
I rack the slide.
I can shoot the leg or arm, no problem.
I put my dukes up and begin displaying some nimble footwork.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Uh, what?
What? Aren't you gonna make a move?

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: Y-you are the Commander I'm thinking of, aren't you?
Yeah, that's me.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: S-so, you're pickin' a fight with a legendary man

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: who crawled all the way up from the slums?
Looks like it. Now quit talking and come at me.
The event starts soon.
*Thud*
With a look of frustration, the man falls to his knees and raises both hands.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: I've... lost.
... Huh?
*Click*

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Pal!

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Master! Are you all right?
Yeah, I'm fine.
You two okay?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Thank goodness...

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: I'm fine, as you can see.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Holy crap, Pal, you defeated him without leaving a scratch on him!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: How'd you pull that off?
Well...

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: It was a fierce battle,

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: and I lost by just a hair.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: So this guy's been running his business with nothing but his mouth all this time?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: It's a relief.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Thanks to Miss Rouge and Miss Bay, everything's under control outside as well...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: The mission is a success.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Congratulations, Master. And to you as well, Miss Milk.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Phew. Thought this one'd be a breeze, but didn't expect it to get this messy.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Still, it's been a while since we teamed up, huh, Pal? Gotta admit, that was fun.
Yeah. I'm glad everything worked out.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: ... I would very much like to change out of this embarrassing outfit and return to wearing my maid uniform.
Sure thing. Good work, Ade.
Hmm... I kinda wanna see you in that bunny girl outfit some more.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Hehe, indeed. You've worked hard as well, Master.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: M-Master...
Wooooooo!
Suddenly, raucous cheering erupts from the direction of the Main Hall.
What's going on?

lines.speaker: rouge_b_op
lines.text: The event countdown has officially begun.
All right, we'll start heading your way.

lines.speaker: rouge_b_op
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work, Highroller.

lines.speaker: rouge_b_op
lines.text: I'll be waiting for you in the Main Hall.
